original_internal_pipe_limit: Only original exposed Python/native workflow streams and original run_all-logs are saved. Inner compiler/test capture_output pipes and cleaned NativeBuild scratch are not claimed as separate raw pipes.

cache_consumers_before.limit: Observed /proc exe/cwd/fd only; not a claim of universal process visibility. Root scheduler cache-quiescence authorization is separately required.

cache_preservation.method: atomic directory rename on same filesystem; no deletion or hardlink backup
